routing_population.pool_policy: exact fixed R1 request repeated with stable request IDs

load.queue: single FIFO worker per loaded native model

analysis.timing_boundary: arrival-to-completion including queueing, native inference and packaging
analysis.rmax: closed-loop increasing concurrency until throughput stops rising

known_deviations: The recovered R1 source contains one fixed routing request rather than a 50-variant prompt artifact; no prompt variants are fabricated.
D_separate is skipped unless a second dedicated A100 passes the zero-resident-process gate.
The v1.5 C3 source protocol did not specify a fixed duration for Rmax levels; the continuation records the duration used in the receipt.
